messages:
Maya: Hi team, I'm Maya (joined Eng-runtime). Day 1 task: run the onboarding smoke tests against staging but I don't have Console write access to toggle the feature flag used by the tests. Should I request personal admin or is there a preferred service-account pattern?

Jordan: Welcome Maya! We avoid personal admin. Request a short-lived service account scoped to the staging project with the ff-operator role.

Maya: Thanks. I tried the access portal but not sure which role to pick for toggles vs viewing.

Ivy: Use staging-ff-operator for programmatic toggles and staging-console-read for UI. If you need to inspect flag rollout in the Console UI, we can add you to staging-console-read temporarily.

Maya: Can someone create the SA? I don't have permission to create one. 2-3 hour TTL is fine.

Jordan: I can create it. What name do you want? Also tagging ops-bot for audit note.

Maya: pref: maya-onboard-e2e-1812345678

ops-bot: FYI creating SA maya-onboard-e2e-1812345678 will generate an audit ticket and require a short justification tag. See https://go/redwood-infra/sa-policy.

Jordan: Created SA and uploaded token to secrets at projects/redwood-secrets/staging/maya-onboard. TTL 3h. Added ff-operator role.

Maya: Got it, fetched token and ran the smoke tests. Toggling worked and tests passed past the feature-gated steps. Thanks!

Kai: Quick note: for recurring CI you can request a rotated SA with automated secret sync. Ping infra if you want that long-term.

Maya: Will do once onboarding tests are stable. Appreciate the help :smile:
